title: Q-ULTRA-loop-ledger-spend-UNMEASURED: essential variable loop-ledger:spend cannot be read
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** `loop-ledger:spend` has no fresh reading (source tenant.spend_vs_budget)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation ultrastability --status
**Status:** closed

An unmeasured variable is never in bounds and never a reason to change the system. Make the reading (probe, writer or fresh ledger row) so the loop can judge it.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation ultrastability --status` shows `loop-ledger:spend` with a value.


**Vacuous:** 2026-11-21T15:31:14Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists


**Evidence:** closing probe passes on main (2026-11-21); the contract verdict was vacuous because the item was filed from a transient reading and the probe never failed after filing. Closed by queue.close with this evidence.
